# get_full_rich_message()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.get_full_rich_message`

## Signature

```python
async def get_full_rich_message(chat_id: Union[int, str], message_id: int) -> Optional['types.RichMessage']: ...
```

## Documentation

Get the full version of a rich message received partially (see [`RichMessage`](../../types/rich_messages/RichMessage.md)
`is_full`).

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`chat_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  Unique identifier (int) or username (str) of the chat the message belongs to.

- **`message_id`** (`int`)
  Identifier of the message.

### Returns

[`RichMessage`](../../types/rich_messages/RichMessage.md): On success, the full rich message is returned; None if the message
has no rich message.

### Example

```python
rich_message = await app.get_full_rich_message(chat_id, message_id)
```
